title: Production, life and legacy
notes: Tour production is completely new: design lights, video walls, pyro, catwalks, a B-stage, strings and a signature moment, previewed in 3D. Bigger venues unlock bigger shows, every piece costs money every night, and pyro can go wrong.
Tours now have a nightly 'Tonight in <city>' report with star ratings and a tour diary.
Rehearse with your band, meet your band members, look after your voice, record a live album, and plan your awards-show performance.
Radio tours: pick three stations. Merch: design your shirt and set prices.
Business: sell or buy back your publishing, sue your old label, quarterly label meetings, endorsements, open your own bar on Broadway, charity and a hospital wing.
Love and life: dating milestones, a wedding planner, divorce settlements, exes who come back, friendships that break, a full rehab story, secrets from the past, a stalker and parenting on the road.
Fame: interviews, staged photo ops, a deeper reality show, a documentary, Darlene the fan-club president and many more livestream questions.
Episodes: weekly acts, 'Meanwhile…' scenes, closing montages, season opening titles and 'Six months later' premieres.
Town: a Nashville map with local legends, CMA Fest, Fourth of July, Christmas at the Opry, and the Music City Gazette.
Legacy: mentor a protégé, the Hall of Fame, a farewell tour, pass the torch, a legacy museum and 'What if…' timelines.

Plus: daily challenges, a rival newcomer, show-moment trophies, photo mode, a songwriting notebook, tribute nights, unlockable outfits, optional background music, NashvillePedia and a first-week guide.
